instruction.text: Tony brought 20 cupcakes to school to share between 10 people. Fill in the gaps to find out how many cupcakes each person gets.

atoms.a: Divide the number of cupcakes by the number of children.

instruction.text: Clara wants to paint stripes on her bedroom wall. The wall is 10 m long and she wants to paint 10 stripes. Fill in the gaps to find out the length of each stripe.

atoms.a: Divide the length of the wall by the number of stripes.

instruction.text: For Christmas this year my grandparents gave me and my cousins a total of £300 between the 10 of us. Fill in the gaps to find out how much each person got.

atoms.a: Divide the amount of money by the number of children.

instruction.text: Jack wants to make 1/10 of a cake recipe. The original recipe uses 1,150 g of sugar. Fill in the gaps to find out how much sugar Jack should use.
Match the sum with the correct answer.
